original: y_t=sum_k p[t,k]*f[e[t,k]](x_t),with the same external routed scaling/shared-expert contract.
relocation: For a bijection P,keep original TopK slots/probabilities,send P(e[t,k]),and define f_new[P(e)]=f_old[e]. Then every summand and the ordered sum agree in this abstract function domain.
replication: For each assignment (t,k),select exactly one physical member in replicas(e[t,k]),each computing the same f[e]. Keep its original coefficient and combine position. Sending every assignment to all replicas changes the sum.
conditions: Packed weights/scales/offsets/activation/SwiGLU limit and any adapters preserve the same expert function.
Native grouped arithmetic/quantization/tile changes must satisfy the declared numeric tolerance; algebra alone does not prove bitwise identity.
Map and weight generations,buffer lifetime,capture addresses,rank/collective agreement and exactly-one assignment hold.
Changing score-column order before TopK may change ties. Post-original-routing ID relabel is the scoped identity,not an assumption that all gate permutations preserve selection.
excluded_shortcuts: Changing IDs while retaining old weights in the selected physical slots.
Moving only weights while dispatch IDs still name the old physical owners.
Moving INT8 weights without their floating and packed scales.
Treating FORCE_EPLB/random IDs as the same model.
